notes: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse, printed: 'Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 green Cat creature token.' 'Each turn' includes the OPPONENT's turns. The turn is advanced to the opponent's turn 2, and there I cast two Opts (instants: 'Scry 1. Draw a card.'): my first and second card drawn in that turn, so one Cat is made. (I draw nothing in turn 1, and none at the opponent's draw step.)
